description: A federal contracting reference hub for small businesses navigating SAM.gov registration, set-aside certifications, and GSA Schedules.
tagline: The small business reference hub for federal contracting.
image_alt: Washington DC Review — federal contracting resource for small businesses.

authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our editorial team researches and documents federal contracting requirements to help small businesses navigate SAM.gov and certification processes.

editorial.how_we_test: We research primary sources from SAM.gov, the SBA, and GSA, summarizing regulations and submission requirements. We are not a government agency and do not offer legal or compliance advice.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We generate revenue through lead generation and referral bounties to specialized GovCon service providers. If you engage a provider through our links, we may earn a commission.
editorial.corrections: If we misstate a regulation or process, we update the page and note the date of the correction. We encourage readers to always consult primary government sources.
